selection_source.record: Current task: implement WebGPT PR sequence; PR 1 explicitly records Graham's selection of Proof Workshop.

identical_board_content.reported_claim: A claim is permissible only when traceable to evidence and a local boundary.
identical_board_content.deterministic_rule: Claim, evidence, gap, and judgment must have different structural roles.
identical_board_content.does_not_prove: whole-site bespoke compliance, blind recognition, accessibility, performance, or Impeccable G16-G18 finish review

territories.name: Annotated Evidence Ledger
territories.composition_model: ledger columns with claim lane, evidence lane, and boundary lane

territories.name: Calibration Path
territories.composition_model: ordered calibration path where waypoints carry the same evidence payload

selection_rationale: Best preserves the claim -> evidence -> bounded-judgment premise as a structural system rather than a page skin.
Keeps evidence visually dominant while leaving room for different section compositions in later PRs.
Creates a stronger guard against generic AI-portfolio styling than a ledger-only or path-only metaphor.

rejected_territories.reason: Strong component discipline, but as the whole site it risks repeating receipt-card or ledger chrome across unrelated beats.
Useful for About and sequence-specific surfaces, but as the whole site it risks ornamental path/graph behavior and weaker dense evidence hierarchy.

does_not_prove: Impeccable G16, G17, or G18 finish review
